sermon.title: Modeling Heaven - November 12, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: The final message on serving God in every season shows how Joshua and kings like Azariah, Hezekiah and Josiah were examples for generations, and how Josiah broke a curse in one generation. Israel’s cycle in Judges warns against a spiral relationship with God, and the call is to model heaven, where elders and angels worship continually, and to take communion.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The service opens with worship (lyrics as captioned) and a special song (“My Jesus”); the message begins at about 29:12. The Assyrian king’s name was not clear in the captions.
